title: Multi-Variable Conformal Prediction: Optimizing Prediction Sets using Multiple Calibration Variables
abstract: arXiv:2605.12341v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Split conformal prediction constructs prediction sets with finite-sample coverage guarantees, but its calibration stage is limited to adjusting a single threshold parameter. Hence, the shape of the prediction sets must be fixed beforehand, typically by fitting it on a reserved part of the calibration data. We introduce multi-variable conformal prediction (MCP), a framework that jointly optimizes and calibrates multiple prediction-set parameters in a single optimization problem, eliminating calibration data split without sacrificing finite-sample coverage guarantees. translated_title: 多变量保形预测：使用多个校准变量优化预测集
translated_abstract: 分裂保形预测能够构建具有有限样本覆盖保证的预测集，但其校准阶段仅限于调整单一阈值参数。因此，预测集的形状必须事先固定，通常需要在校准数据的预留部分上进行拟合。我们提出了多变量保形预测（MCP），这是一个在单个优化问题中联合优化和校准多个预测集参数的框架，在不牺牲有限样本覆盖保证的前提下，消除了校准数据分割的必要。基于情景理论——一个用于认证数据驱动决策的原则性框架——我们提出了两个易于求解的变体：RemMCP，基于带约束移除的约束优化，它推广了分裂保形预测；以及RelMCP，基于带约束松弛的惩罚优化，它还支持非凸问题，尽管计算成本更高。
tldr: 该论文提出多变量保形预测（MCP）框架，通过在单个优化问题中联合优化和校准多个预测集参数，消除了校准数据分割的需求且不牺牲有限样本覆盖保证，并基于情景理论提出了RemMCP和RelMCP两个可求解的变体。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Multi-Variable Conformal Prediction (MCP), a framework that jointly optimizes and calibrates multiple prediction-set parameters in a single optimization problem, eliminating calibration data splits while preserving finite-sample coverage guarantees, and proposes two tractable variants, RemMCP and RelMCP, grounded in scenario theory.
